ns2:course.label: Genes and Behavior
ns2:course.description: Concepts, methods, and problems in the analysis of the relationship between genes and behavior, the complex neurobiological processes that mediate action on behavior, in appropriate ecological and evolutionary contexts. Same as ANTH 432, NEUR 432, and PSYC 432. Prerequisite: IB 150 and either IB 204 or IB 429 or consent of instructor.
